title: Spirited Away
overview: On the way to a new home, ten-year-old Chihiro wanders into a spirit world where her parents are transformed. To save them she takes a job at a bathhouse for gods, and slowly learns who she is.
review: Still the most generous film I know. Every corner of the bathhouse feels lived in.
reflections: This time I noticed how much of the film is about work — learning a job, being useful, earning a place. Chihiro grows up by doing small things well.
notes: The music on the train scene carries the whole sequence with almost no dialogue.

highlights.text: The silent train ride across the flooded sea.
No-Face quietly sitting next to Chihiro on the train.
